sloka: सन्त्रस्तहृदयाः सर्वे प्राकारादवरुह्य ते ।विषण्णवदना घोरा राक्षसेन्द्रमुपस्थिताः ।। ६.५१.१० ।।।।
transliteration: santrastahṛdayāḥ sarve prākārādavaruhya te ।viṣaṇṇavadanā ghorā rākṣasendramupasthitāḥ ।। 6.51.10 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana having said so, the bewildered Rakshasas scaling the boundary wall beheld the army protected by great Sugriva and the prosperous Raghavas relieved from arrows and happy, he became worried.
